metadata.title: Escalation demo
metadata.description: Minimal workflow for exercising the remote-human gate escalation surface: a run node publishes a change, then parks on a human merge-authorization gate until a bridge records an attributed decision.

action.instructions: A caller (human or agent) completes the change being published. Complete this node with a summary, the repository, the pull request number, and the exact head SHA under review.

A human authorizes merging the exact PR head that was published. Complete this node with the authorized head SHA, then satisfy the merge-authorization gate with the exact subject (repository, pull request, and head SHA). The gate cannot be satisfied by PR state alone.
Record the merge outcome. Complete this node with the terminal outcome 'merged' once the authorized head is merged, or 'abandoned' if the work unit is closed out without merging.
